description: This PHP source file defines a class HomeViewModulelistmenu extending ViewModulelistmenu, with a display method that retrieves recently viewed items and renders a template for the module list menu in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: HomeViewModulelistmenu
classes.description: A view class responsible for displaying the module list menu with recently viewed items.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Fetches recently viewed items for the current user, processes them to include item summaries and images, assigns them to the view, and renders the module list menu template.
